parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Coefficient of $x^3$ in $(1-3x)^6$ is $-20\times3^3=-540$ (**B1**); coefficient in $(1+ax)^5$ is $10a^3$ (**B1**). Use $-540+10a^3=100$ (**M1**; all three terms including $10a^3$ and $100$ required). $a=4$ (**A1**).
